The '''Periwinkle''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught using a [[Crab Pot]] in any [[Crab Pot#Freshwater|freshwater]] body of water. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It can also randomly be found at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|20}}. Like all fish caught from the crab pot, it cannot be eaten unless it is used in a [[Cooking]] recipe.

==Tailoring==
Periwinkle can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Rain Coat]].  [[File:Shirt260.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Periwinkles can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every day. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. Typical output includes light blue Periwinkle [[Roe]], [[Green Algae]], and various [[Trash]] items, but more valuable items are possible starting at population 5.

==Quests==
* One Periwinkle may be requested by several fish in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond]] quests.
* Five Periwinkle may be requested by [[Giant Stump#Questline|The Raccoon]] as part of the first request or as part of the sixth request and beyond.

==Note==
Periwinkle will never sell for more than {{Price|37}} under any circumstances, making it more profitable to turn them into [[Sashimi]] (worth {{Price|75}}) before selling them.
